put.summary: Configure the application global settings
put.description:
Updates global parameters using a key-value setting.


Allowed keys are: 


CUSTOM_HEADERS: a list of allowed header names separated by whitespaces that are going to be forwarded to VDP when a connection is made


QUERY_TIMEOUT. Maximum time in milliseconds that the query will wait for the statement to be completed. If not indicated (or you enter 0 as a value), then it will wait until the execution is complete. By default it is 900,000 milliseconds.


CHUNK_TIMEOUT. Maximum time in milliseconds that the query will wait until it arrives a new chunk of results. Where this time is exceeded, Virtual DataPort returns the results extracted up to that moment. If not specified (or you enter 0 as a value), Virtual DataPort returns all the results together at the end of the statement run. By default it is 90,000 milliseconds.


CHUNK_SIZE. Number of results that make up a chunk of results. When Virtual DataPort Tool obtains this number of results, it will return them to the Data Marketplace, even though the Chunk timeout has not been reached. By default it is 1,000 rows.


LOV_ENABLED. Enable and disable the functionality of selecting values from a column during filter creation.


VQL_SHELL_USER_AGENT_DATA_MARKETPLACE: the user agent sent from the Data Marketplace VQL shell.

loggerName.description: Logger name. If empty, it changes the Root.

db.description: Database of the element of the field used to filter tuples in the simple condition.

view.description: Element (view or rest) of the field in the simple condition.

field.description: Field used to filter in the simple condition.

operator.description: Operator used to filter tuples by these field values in the simple condition.

value.description: Value used to compare the field in the simple condition. Using "value", the field "multiValue" takes the null value.

multiValue.description: Values used in multivalued operators to compare the field in the simple condition.

items.description: Values used in multivalued operators to compare the field in the simple condition.

expression.description: Expression used to filter tuples. This attribute is only used when the attribute field is null.

having.description: Flag to indicate if this is a WHERE condition or a HAVING condition

SearchConditionDto.description: Condition that a tuple has to meet to appear in the results.

field.description: Field name used in the 'group by' sentence.

expression.description: Expression used in the 'group by' sentence.

visible.description: Internal use of Data Marketplace. Boolean value to determine if the value of the field is visible.

expandFields.description: Expanded field used in the 'group by'.

role.description: Name of the element where the field used for the 'group by' sentence is contained.

db.description: Name of the database element where the field used for the 'group by' sentence is contained.

multiple.description: Internal use of Data Marketplace. Boolean value, it indicates if many members of the view participate in the relationship.

SearchGroupByFieldDto.description: Field used in the 'group by' sentence.

database.description: Database of the element on which the query is executed. Is mandatory for DATA_PREPARATION, REST, SOAP and VIEW but not for VQL_SHELL type queries.

view.description: Element on which the query is executed.

type.description: Type of the element (view or rest).

simpleConditions.description: Condition that a tuple has to meet to appear in the results.

groupByEnabled.description: Boolean to determine if the 'group by' sentence is used.

groupByFields.description: Field used in the 'group by' sentence.

orderByFields.description: Field that will determine how the tuples in the query results are arranged.

outputFields.description: Field that will determine how the tuples in the query results are arranged.

id.description: Query identifier. Applies only to saved queries.

expressionType.description:
pick appropiate expression type:
  - PROJECTION_CONDITION: SELECT clauses regular expressions
  - PROJECTION_AGGREGATE: SELECT clauses for aggregate expressions
  - SELECTION: WHERE clauses alike expressions
  - GROUP_BY: GROUP BY clauses
  - HAVING: HAVING clauses
  - ORDER_BY: ORDER BY expression
  - JOIN: JOIN clauses
  - ASSOCIATION: association between fields and only fields
  - SOURCE_TYPE_INTERFACE: expressions for source type properties for INTERFACE views
  - SOURCE_TYPE_BASEVIEW: expressions for source type properties for base views
  - CONDITION: expressions with scalar functions
  - AGGREGATION: expressions with aggregate functions
  - ANY_FUNCTION: expressions with any type of function

proceedWithConflicts.description:
Decision in case of conflicts. That is, action to do if the metadata of an element (e.g. the description
    of a view) has changed in Virtual DataPort and in the Data Marketplace since the last time the metadata
    was synchronized. The actions available are:
    server_with_local_changes: (default value): changes in Virtual DataPort are retrieved but keeping the changes in local elements modified in the Data Marketplace.
    local: changes in the Data Marketplace have priority over changes in Virtual DataPort.
    server: changes in Virtual DataPort override changes on the Data Marketplace.
